User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user profile and their progress within the AI-Band-Builder application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

nativeLanguage.description: User's native language for multilingual support.

learningPathId.description: Reference to the LearningPath entity. (Relationship: User 1:1 LearningPath)

totalPracticeTime.description: Total time spent by the user in practice sessions.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Represents a static curriculum lesson within the AI-Band-Builder application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the lesson entity.

type.description: Type of lesson (e.g., Grammar, Vocabulary, Tips, Reading, Listening).

level.description: Difficulty level of the lesson (e.g., Basic, Intermediate, Advanced).

content_native.description: Basic explanation in the user's native language.

MockTest.title: MockTest
MockTest.description: Represents a mock test definition within the AI-Band-Builder application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the mock test entity.

testType.description: Type of test (e.g., IELTS-Academic, PTE, IELTS-General).

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Represents a user's submission and the AI-generated results within the AI-Band-Builder application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the submission entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: User 1:N Submission)

testId.description: Reference to the MockTest or Lesson entity. (Relationship: MockTest/Lesson 1:N Submission)

skill.description: Skill assessed in the submission (e.g., Writing, Speaking, GrammarPractice).

inputData.description: The student's text response or the Firebase Storage URL for their audio recording.

aiReport.description: Structured JSON report generated by the Gemini API.

scoreBand.description: The numerical band score assigned by the AI.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the AI-Band-Builder application, focusing on scalability, security, and ease of querying. It adheres to the principles of Authorization Independence (denormalization), Structural Segregation (homogeneous security posture), and Access Modeling (standardized patterns).  

*   **/users/{userId}**: Stores user profiles.  This collection is path-based and inherently private, enabling simple security rules based on `request.auth.uid == userId`.  
*   **/lessons/{lessonId}**: Contains static curriculum content. These documents are generally readable, and security rules can control write access based on admin roles (DBAC via existence checks).
*   **/mockTests/{testId}**: Defines mock tests. Similar to lessons, read access can be public or restricted, with write access controlled by admin roles.
*   **/users/{userId}/submissions/{submissionId}**: Stores user submissions and AI results.  This is a subcollection of users which follows path-based ownership. This provides a secure and scalable way to manage submissions, enabling efficient querying for user progress.  It also allows for simple and robust security rules.

**Authorization Independence:** The structure avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies by using path-based ownership for user-specific data (e.g., `/users/{userId}/submissions/{submissionId}`). There is no reliance on `get()` calls to parent documents for authorization.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure enables secure `list` operations by segregating data based on ownership (users and submissions). For listing submissions, the query is scoped to a specific user's subcollection, preventing the need for filtering based on user ID within the rules.

This design promotes clarity and maintainability, crucial for long-term development and debugging.
